ChIP assay showed that FosB binds to the lncARF promoter at the −574 to −565 site.
Mutation of the −574 to −565 region directly decreased the transcriptional activity of lncARF.
Knockdown of FosB dramatically decreased the transcriptional activity and expression of lncARF in foam cells, and increased the DNA methylation level of the lncARF promoter.
Co-immunoprecipitation assay observed a potential interaction between FosB and DNMT1.
Strong interaction was demonstrated between DNMT1 and the vector containing the 155-218aa domain of FosB.
Deleting the 155-218aa domain significantly reduced the levels of lncARF.
ChIP assay revealed that silencing FosB led to a substantial increase in DNMT1 binding to the lncARF promoter in foam cells treated with Hcy.
